notes: Item 19 reports Gross Sales for fiscal year 2025 across 58 franchised everbowl Stores (out of 95 total). Data is presented as top and bottom performance bands (10%, 25%, 33%, 50%). Each band reports average, median, highest, and lowest Gross Sales, plus the count and percentage of stores meeting or exceeding the average. The Data Set excluded 37 stores: 16 opened in 2025 (not full-year), 2 closed >1 month for relocation, 7 with vendor/menu issues, and 12 Non-Traditional Venues or training centers. The Data Set also includes 10 stores briefly operated by affiliates. No cost, profit, or other financial metrics are disclosed. Confidence slightly below 1.0 due to minor OCR formatting variations and the dual-role (franchisee/affiliate) of 10 stores in the dataset.
